parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Use the provenance-rich join path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_structures (INNER JOIN) -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL5251, standard_type IC50, and require canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Return all requested columns exactly: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by all requested columns in ascending order.
